Honey-Data-V2 is the corpus of the journal version of Bee, Bee: A High-Quality Corpus and Full-Stack
Suite for End-to-End Training of Fully Open MLLMs, accepted to Computational Visual Media. The
conference version (ICLR 2026) released Honey-Data-15M
and the Bee-8B models trained
on it. The journal version scales the corpus up by reapplying the same curation… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/HoneyDataV2/Honey-Data-V2.
